title: Valuation Surges to $13.3 Billion! European Hot AI Programming Startup Lovable Secures $40 Million in Series C Funding

content_html:
Recently, the highly anticipated AI programming star Lovable in Europe has officially confirmed a new round of substantial financing. The company successfully secured 40 million USD in its latest Series C funding round, with its overall valuation significantly rising to 13.3 billion USD. This round was co-led by Menlo Ventures and Scaleup Europe Fund, and attracted more than ten investment institutions.

Previously, Lovable had completed a 330 million USD financing in December of last year, with an estimated valuation of around 6.6 billion USD. The rapid growth of its business has been the core driver behind its valuation doubling quickly. Officially, as of June this year, the company's annual recurring revenue (ARR) has officially surpassed 500 million USD.

With the rapid expansion of its business scale, Lovable's platform ecosystem has also undergone a comprehensive upgrade. Currently, the platform hosts about 60 million projects and attracts up to 900 million visits per month. To support the massive backend demand, the company has not only integrated various cutting-edge large models but also launched its own AI model trained in-house. In June this year, Lovable entered into a multi-year deep partnership with Google Cloud, and its computing power and service usage volume have increased fivefold.

In addition to its vigorous business development, Lovable has also begun actively contributing to the local AI ecosystem in Europe. For example, the company recently invested in the Danish startup Atech, supporting the development of AI programming software specifically designed for designing tech hardware. With the influx of new funds and the continuous expansion of its ecosystem, Lovable is accelerating its efforts to solidify its leading position in the global AI-assisted development field.

content_html_zh:
近日，欧洲备受期待的AI编程明星Lovable正式确认新一轮大幅融资。 公司最新一轮C轮融资成功获得4000万美元，整体估值大幅提升至133亿美元。 本轮由Menlo Ventures和Scaleup Europe Fund共同领投，吸引了十余家投资机构。

此前，Lovable已于去年12月完成3.3亿美元融资，预计估值约66亿美元。 业务的快速增长是其估值快速翻倍的核心驱动力。 据官方统计，截至今年6月，该公司的年度经常性收入（ARR）已正式突破5亿美元。

随着业务规模的快速扩张，Lovable的平台生态系统也进行了全面升级。 目前，该平台承载约6000万个项目，每月吸引高达9亿次访问。 为了支持海量的后端需求，该公司不仅集成了各种前沿的大型模型，还推出了自己内部训练的人工智能模型。 今年6月，Lovable与谷歌云达成多年深度合作，算力和服务使用量增长了五倍。

除了蓬勃发展的业务外，Lovable也开始积极为欧洲当地的AI生态系统做出贡献。 例如，该公司最近投资了丹麦初创公司 Atech，支持开发专门用于设计科技硬件的人工智能编程软件。 随着新资金的涌入和生态系统的不断扩大，Lovable正在加紧发力，巩固其在全球AI辅助开发领域的领先地位。
